text: Thanks for the Node note: folded in as our u14, and install.sh's node check will enforce whatever minimum you settle. Separately, install-uninstall-update now depends on releases being git tags. install.sh is fetched from a pinned tag URL and records the tag and commit hash in .claude/ang/version.json, and the upgrade skill baselines from that, so the 'starters have no tags' option would break install and upgrade. Any release process you pick also needs one step before tagging: write the tag into install.sh (our open unknown u12, which you may want to own). Details: shaping/install-uninstall-update/shaping-content/install-script-spike.md on stream/install-uninstall-update.
